subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should the durable block-streaming contract preserve paragraph boundaries as in-band text on chunks, carry explicit boundary metadata through delivery, or accept a limited text-only repair for common cases?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and active PRs exist, but the near-maxChars separator case changes the streaming payload contract and needs maintainer intent before one implementation is selected.

options.title: Consolidate a complete shared fix
options.body: Choose one candidate or replacement and require it to preserve paragraph boundaries across in-budget and near-maxChars splits before merging.

options.title: Adopt explicit boundary metadata
options.body: Carry seam kind through chunker, subscriber, and coalescer if maintainers want correctness independent of text length limits.

options.title: Accept a partial text-only repair
options.body: Land the common-case separator fix while documenting the near-limit boundary as remaining work on this issue.

recommendation.title: Consolidate a complete shared fix
recommendation.body: Choose one candidate or replacement and require it to preserve paragraph boundaries across in-budget and near-maxChars splits before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has strong history on block-reply coalescing and chunking hardening, making it the best available owner for the contract choice.
